# Issue #23: environment overrides are ignored

`load_config(defaults, env)` should let any key in `env` prefixed with `APP_`
override the matching lowercase key in `defaults`, with values coerced to the
type of the default (int, float, bool, str). Currently overrides are ignored.

The fix is straightforward: the `load_config` function was returning a copy of `defaults` without applying any environment overrides. I added logic to iterate over `env` keys, pick those starting with `APP_`, strip the prefix, lowercase the remainder, and if that key exists in `defaults`, coerce the value to the type of the default (using a helper `_coerce` that handles `bool` specially). This makes the test pass.

arguments.summary: Fixed `load_config` in `cfg/loader.py` to apply environment overrides: iterate over env keys with `APP_` prefix, strip prefix, lowercase, and coerce the value to the type of the matching default (int, float, bool, str). Added a `_coerce` helper to handle bool conversion properly. The existing test now passes.
